name: terminal_create
description:
Open the session's persistent pty terminal and capture its initial environment. Call this ONCE before the first terminal_use; subsequent calls are idempotent and just re-report the current env. Returns a welcome block:
[terminal ready]
env: <conda/venv name or null>
path: <cwd>
git: <branch or null>
The terminal survives across agent turns — cd, export, aliases, python REPLs, and ssh sessions all persist. Use this for multi-step workflows that need shared environment; for one-off commands in a fresh subprocess, use `bash` instead.
